name: Technikelfe Unused Media Finder
author: Sara Menzel-Berger

sections.description:
Technikelfe Unused Media Finder is an easy-to-use plugin to clean up your media library. It
analyzes your files and tells you what media is not used in any page, post, cpt,
plugin and theme. Those unused media can be deleted directly through the Remove
Unused Media dashboard. Additionally, the plugin shows you where your used media
are implemented, so you can directly see on what page, post, cpt, plugin or where
in your theme they are used.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services under certain conditions:

Technikelfe Analytics Service

This plugin connects to our analytics API at remove-unused-media.com to improve the stability and quality of the plugin.

When data is sent:
* Optionally, when you opt-in to share usage data to help us improve the plugin
* When you submit an error report after an analysis failure

What data is sent (usage analytics, opt-in only):
* Site URL
* Plugin version
* Number of used, ignored, and unused media files
* Number of trashed and deleted media files
* Number of analyses performed
* Number of posts
* PHP version
* WordPress version
* List of installed plugins (names only)

What data is sent (error reports):
* Site URL
* Error details and debug log

This data is used to improve the stability of the plugin and to help diagnose issues.

  • Service provider: Technikelfe (remove-unused-media.com)
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

Freemius

This plugin uses Freemius for license management and plugin updates.

When data is sent:
* During plugin activation and license validation
* When checking for plugin updates

What data is sent:
* Site URL and WordPress version
* Plugin activation status
* License key (if applicable)

  • Service provider: Freemius
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
